description: This file is a PHP unit test for the CustomFieldModel class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the toArray() method of the CustomFieldModel class. It verifies the conversion of a CustomField entity into an array representation.

classes.name: CustomFieldModelTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the CustomFieldModel's ability to convert a CustomField entity into an associative array.

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Test method that creates a CustomField entity, maps it through CustomFieldModel, and asserts that the resulting array matches the expected output.
